remarks:
A one-of-a-kind country retreat with unforgettable views and year-round comfort! Tucked away on approximately 6.7 acres, this charming property is filled with warmth, character, and thoughtful details, many handcrafted by the current owner.

Beautiful woodwork gives the home a cozy, welcoming feel throughout. A room off the side entrance is currently used as a bedroom, while the spacious primary bedroom offers three closets and previously accommodated a stackable washer and dryer (although the lines would need to be added). Upstairs, the loft is arranged into two separate sleeping areas, currently with a twin bed in the front section and a double bed in the rear.

A propane wall heater can be accessed remotely, allowing the temperature to be managed while you're away, while a wood stove serves as the primary heat source and adds to the rustic charm.

Outside, the views stretch for miles. The land is arranged on two distinct levels. The main homesite is served by its own 1,000-gallon septic system and well. On the lower level, where a double-wide once stood, the structure has been removed while the existing well and 500-gallon septic system and electric service remain.

Also on the lower level is a unique utility building equipped with a toilet, sink, window, and electric. Additional storage includes a shed, a garage-style building suitable for tractors, mowers, and equipment, plus a full metal storage pod.

A stocked pond adds another special feature to the setting, offering a peaceful place to enjoy the outdoors and surrounding scenery.

Whether you're looking for a private getaway, recreational retreat, or simply a special place to escape the everyday, this property offers space, charm, views, and amenities that make it truly memorable.

Please note this property is located off a seasonal road that is the responsibility of the buyer to plow in the winter and maintain throughout the year.
